name: drift
title: Drift
description: A slow constant camera push-in, so no scene is ever frozen. Plays on a built-in placeholder scene.
useWhen: Any static scene should feel alive: hero cards, feature panels, dashboards sitting between transitions.
You want an anti-static wrapper: a constant, barely noticeable creep.
avoidWhen: The content already has strong motion: drift on top doubles the movement and muddies the read.
You need a dramatic zoom: this is a creep, not a statement; use a real scale animation or zoom-blur.
author: Remocn

variables.label: Grow
variables.description: Final scale is 1 + grow. Negative values pull back instead. 0.03 to 0.05 reads as ambient motion.

variables.label: Placeholder scene
variables.description: Show the built-in placeholder scene. Turn off to leave the frame empty.

variables.label: Duration
variables.description: Seconds the push-in takes (the block length).
